display_name: 화이트 벽·화이트 테이블 확산광 단일 제품

composition.subject_anchor_priority: one complete product remains within 16-24 percent height and 18 percent width while at least 68 percent of the frame remains meaningful space

environment.background_plane: one real warm-neutral white wall meeting one matte white tabletop near y=0.80-0.84
environment.surface_character: quiet physical wall and table variation without decorative props or repeated AI texture
environment.sun_patch_shape: none; use only broad diffused tonal falloff

lighting.source: one very large left window diffused by overcast sky or a thin curtain
lighting.shadow_description: one soft attached base shadow and a broad low-density rightward falloff
lighting.ambient_fill: weak neutral room bounce that preserves product and support contact
lighting.highlight_behavior: broad protected highlights with visible wall, table and glass detail
lighting.shadow_temperature: neutral to faintly cool relative to the warm-neutral wall

capture.shadow_processing: keep gentle depth and do not flatten the product into the white planes
capture.local_texture: retain beverage layers, glass fluting, rim thickness, wall variation and faint grain

human_rendering.skin_texture: not applicable because no hand is active
human_rendering.light_response: not applicable because no hand is active

material_rules.glass: retain thin circular rim, fine vertical fluting, flat base, refraction and physically connected highlights and shadows
material_rules.plastic: retain thin edge reflections without glass weight; never redesign the source container unless adopt_reference is selected
material_rules.paper: remain opaque with soft fiber response; never reveal beverage layers through the wall
material_rules.ceramic: retain matte or glazed ceramic response and never invent a logo on an unbranded surface

coupling_rules: Product, table and wall share one left diffused source.
The product scale and wall-table boundary jointly preserve the large top-heavy negative space.
Container highlights, beverage transmission and the table shadow belong to one exposure.
Reference pixels may guide only declared scene grammar and optional container design; exact beverage and wall marks are excluded.

hard_fail: product height exceeds 0.24 or width exceeds 0.18
direct light patch or hard shadow appears
reference beverage, wall mark, text or logo leaks
